consultas_censo.comando:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 THEN 'Turma'
    ELSE 'Outro'
  END AS tipo_turma
FROM matriculas
WHERE QT_MAT_BAS > 0
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 THEN 'Turma'
    ELSE 'Outro'
  END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 THEN 'Turma'
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 AND QT_MAT_BAS < 100 THEN 'Outro'
    ELSE 'Outro'
  END AS tipo_turma
FROM matriculas
WHERE QT_MAT_BAS > 0
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 THEN 'Turma'
    WHEN QT_MAT_BAS > 0 AND QT_MAT_BAS < 100 THEN 'Outro'
    ELSE 'Outro'
  END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
